meta.description: E-commerce content marketing strategy planner. Generates content calendars, topic ideas, and platform-specific strategies by analyzing customer reviews, trends, competitor content, and SEO opportunities. Two modes: (A) Build — create a full content strategy from scratch, (B) Audit — analyze existing content and find gaps. Supports TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, Pinterest, blog/SEO, and Amazon A+. No API key required. Use when: (1) planning content for a new product launch, (2) building a content calendar, (3) finding viral content ideas, (4) analyzing competitor content strategies, (5) extracting customer pain points for content topics.
